open_points.subject: _transport_log_record
open_points.text: _transport_log_record: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST build one line of exactly four labelled fields in this order and shape, so an operator log parser does not change between builds: 'rid=<request id> method=<method> path=<canonical path without query string> status=<status>'.
open_points.other_text: The line is bounded in its fields, not in its length: canonical_path is written whole, exactly as received, and MUST NOT be truncated, shortened or escaped.
open_points.question: When canonical_path contains a query string, must it be removed from the path field, or must canonical_path be written whole exactly as received?

open_points.subject: install_transport_guards
open_points.text: For every request the middleware MUST evaluate the checks below in the order they are written, and the order is a pipeline rather than a choice between alternatives: each check either produces the response named for it and ends the request there, or leaves the request untouched for the next check to evaluate.
open_points.other_text: A POST to /auth/viewer/logout whose Origin is accepted therefore still passes through the body-size check, and so does every other request that is not refused before it.
open_points.question: Does a successful 204 OPTIONS preflight end the request before the body-size check, or must it pass through that check because it was not refused?
